message: 濡れたぎる青春

name: Eddie
message: 「Did you know disposable hand warmers can be reused as deodorizers or fertilizer?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Preside~~nt.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Lolotte. I'll be heading over soon, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since we're checking the water spots today, let's meet up at the church.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it. I'll head over once I'm done with this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll head on ahead then~」

name: Azel
message: 「I believe I told you to go home.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I'm not even done cleaning yet. Besides, I have Student Council next. Actually, you never told me that in the first place.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not you.」
Azel left the classroom as if chasing after Lolotte.
So she wasn't talking to me...

name: Synn
message: 「Agh!! Hey, we're not done cleaning yet!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hold it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeeeek.\s08」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, it's just you, Azel-san. Don't scare me like that~」

name: Azel
message: 「Come.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Come with me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah. W-Wha~~t~」

name: Azel
message: 「Why are you here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh?」

name: Azel
message: 「I believe I told you to go home.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I still have Student Council activities, so I'm not going home yet.」

name: Azel
message: 「Not you.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm telling you to go back to your original world.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eh!? H-H-H-How do you know about that!? Who in the world are you?!」

name: Azel
message: 「I am--」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek, Mr. President?!」

name: Synn
message: 「And even Azel is here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me Azel came to help out too!」

name: Azel
message: 「Not you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see... Then why are you here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, that's right!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You see, Azel is super interested in Student Council activities.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though she's saying she isn't?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's just embarrassed! At times like this--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes! This is what they call a tsundere!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?」
Azel is looking off in a completely different direction.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since you came all the way to this world too, Azel, it'd be a waste not to enjoy yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about global communication.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, okay...\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Um... so, what were we supposed to do today again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you just say it yourself a moment ago? Checking the water sources, right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh right, that's what it was!」

name: Synn
message: 「The faucets in the courtyard venue won't be enough on their own, so we're going to borrow the ones over by the church.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're going to connect hoses and run them over.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you really interested?」
Everyone huddled shoulder to shoulder in front of the faucet.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, the grand unveiling~♪」
I try turning the faucet.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my. The water pressure is quite weak.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Could it be broken?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like this, it'll be hard to use during KiraFes. What should we do?」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, I've got to go report this to Helena-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm~」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong? Groaning like that.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is something troubling you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Sharp as ever. Here, take a look at this.」

name: Synn
message: 「A water bill... statement?」
My eyes practically pop out of my head when I see the numbers.

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh... My glasses, my glasses.」

name: Helena
message: 「Calm down already. You don't even wear glasses.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, with grounds this big--plus we even have a pool--I honestly have no idea what kind of amount is normal for this.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's 100 times the usual amount. 100 times.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Normally, the water here at our Ryuusei Academy is--」

name: Synn
message: 「The water is?」

name: Helena
message: 「So, what did you need?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you normally do for water?! Tell me about the water!」

name: Helena
message: 「Could it be that you started missing me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's... there's no way that's true!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, turning bright red like that--how adorable.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't tease me! I came to report that the church's water pipes are acting up.」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't get mad, don't get mad. Obviously I was just joking.」

name: Helena
message: 「--The church?」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「I smell it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? *Sniff, sniff*...」
Helena-san smells so nice-wait, no, no!!

name: Helena
message: 「I smell a case.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, it's me. About that matter--ah, so it really is the church. Yeah, just talking to someone here. So, think you can handle it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, I see. Got it.」

name: Helena
message: 「The issue is around the church area. Apparently, a construction worker took the initiative and shut off the valve.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's why no water was coming out. Still, that leaves the root of the problem completely unsolved, doesn't it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. Besides, it's a problem if we can't use it like this, so I requested an inspection, though they seem rather swamped and might take a little while to get here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means while we're waiting, the water bill will keep literally inflating.」

name: Helena
message: 「I can't deny that possibility.」

name: Synn
message: 「What a terrible waste!! Please let me handle it!!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's the spirit! Very well, I hereby assign the Student Council the mission of resolving this situation.」

name: Synn
message: 「Roger that, Boss.」

name: Synn
message: 「I got caught up in the moment and talked big...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Impressive as always, President-san! Truly a paragon of thrift.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Do you think so.\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, doesn't it sound kind of fun? Anyway, let's just give it everything we've got!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right. Let's do this!」
For starters, we begin questioning the Sister and the students around the area.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems the Sister only uses the hose to water the flowers.」

name: Synn
message: 「And other than that, it's pretty much just the sports club members using it for drinking water.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Maybe someone is accidentally leaving the water running~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... We can't rule out the possibility that it's broken, either. I wonder if there's any way to track down the cause.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「A pointless endeavor.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, I see! It must be happening because people are being wasteful with it.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First off... let's see. President, why don't we prepare something we can use as a sign?」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you going to do with it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Write a reminder telling everyone to make sure they turn the main valve all the way off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, just doing that feels a little reassuringly thin~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Um, the Sister uses a hose to spray the water, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Apparently, it lets her water everything effortlessly, waste-free, and evenly.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's where the waste is hiding!」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, around here--oh, found it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've gone ahead and let the Chairwoman know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks.」
When I turn the faucet, water comes out just like normal.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Also, I wrote some text on the sign!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It means that wasting water is heavier than life itself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's make it a little easier to understand...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! ♪」
While Lolotte is hard at work on her calligraphy, I fiddle with a certain item I brought from home.

name: Synn
message: 「Now I just need to secure it to the hose.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I fasten it with wire--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, and our shower is complete!」
What I brought is a standard shower head used in household baths.

name: Synn
message: 「Though, this one's different from a normal one.」
I got it from Tame-san's place and added my own modifications to it.

name: Synn
message: 「By making the water holes smaller and temporarily building up water inside the head, it boosts the water pressure when it sprays out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Doing this extends the water's reach, meaning you can spray more water using a smaller volume.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~~」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「And believe it or not, this cuts water consumption by about 50%!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So a hundredfold loss is reduced all the way down to fiftyfold!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I doubt that's gonna have any real effect.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine! After all, we are doing everything we possibly can.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, let's test it out right away.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooh~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Shoots pretty far, doesn't it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, come on. Come take a look too, Azel-san. It's amazing!」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」
Even so, she didn't need to keep that much distance.

name: Synn
message: 「A constant flow no matter how far you open the faucet. That's the secret to saving water.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which means it's totally fine if I turn it all the way on, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? No, don't, Lolotte--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaagh.」
Unable to withstand the pressure, the showerhead pops right off, and the hose thrashes around wildly like a freshly landed fish.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll turn it off, I'll turn it off! So sorryyy.」
Lolotte hurriedly cranks the faucet shut, but she's already completely drenched from the spraying water.
Lolotte's uniform clings tightly to her small body.
Beneath the fabric, faintly blushed pink, a young girl's secrets are thrown into relief.
The undershirt covering her soft swells was completely see-through.
The peaks swell faintly into little mounds, looking as though the color of their tips might show right through.
Droplets dripping down the nape of her neck trace along the curve of her chest.
Teasingly, they slide right over the tips of her buds.
Even though I know in my head she's just squirming from the cold, I can't help finding it alluring.
Lit up by the sunlight, her hair sparkled brilliantly.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaahn. It's cold~」
Lolotte looks young in appearance, sure, but her chest is actually a pretty decent size.
Unlike when she transforms, seeing her in wet clothes is also--no, bad, bad!
Using Student Council activities as an excuse to think such indecent thoughts is strictly off-limits!
Flashing across my mind is her soft, fair skin glistening with moisture.
If I keep thinking about stuff like that, I'm gonna start seeing Lolotte that way.
Shaking off the surging lust and delusions, I rush over to Lolotte's side.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe, I'm soaked all the way through to my underwear.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ngh...... *glance*」
Like I said, bad, bad!
Let's reinforce it more securely so it doesn't pop off again.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright. Think this'll hold?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Achoo.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, we've gotta dry you off quick.」
I dry her hair with a towel.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hau~~」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Dry your body yourself, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much. Oh, President, you're completely drenched too.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine, so-fweh-choo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「See, you have to dry off!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way. If I do that, the towel will get dirty.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's today's Fighting Spirit Award, so there's no need to hold back~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Cut it out.」
Ahh, it smells like Lolotte......
G-Getting all worked up over my junior--I'm a failure as an upperclassman......!

name: Synn
message: 「Aah!! That's enough there, you don't need to wipe there!」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean!?」

name: Azel
message: 「You're defiled.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not dirty......」
